verdict.rationale: Ultrametric does work with the skill format: `ultrametric init` previews and writes its own prebuilt SKILL.md files into .agents/skills and .claude/skills, and those files can be committed. That makes skill authoring a fair axis for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents a template or guide for writing a new skill, and nothing describes the SKILL.md name/description frontmatter. The CLI only installs Ultrametric's own skill.
